rule_or_requirement: Local candidates must finish the qualified line on at least as many matched cells as the selected control before a faster lap can justify advancement.
observable_information: At inference, four grayscale frames and pixel-only road, speed, and obstacle diagnostics; evaluator records finish, action, speed, road contact, and runtime.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Frozen launch acceleration stays active on the opening clear straight; fixed preview wrappers may steer and brake before a visible bend and apply conservative straight gas.
expected_success_endpoint: On 12 previously unused matched tune cells, at least the launch-only completion count and, on a tie, shorter median finished lap time with positive preview activation.
falsifier: Candidate-only nonfinish or lower aggregate completion, invalid actions, resource breach, zero preview activation, or no time improvement on a completion tie.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Compare frozen exact ZIPs on tracks 1-3 by seeds 7000-7003, 12 paired cells, 24 episodes, 2000 decisions each; compare completion before lap time.
resource_and_risk_gate: Registered local Linux CPU profile, 2 CPUs and 2 GiB, 1800 seconds; held-out 7004-7007 and confirmation 7008-7011 remain reserved unless tune and later held-out qualify.
